lastCompletedStory.title: Make per-issue token aggregation marker-aware (delta sum vs legacy collapse)

nextStoryContext: aggregateTokensPerIssue (src/stats/tokens.ts) is now marker-aware: applyCycleTokensDetail branches on detail['orchTokensMode']==='delta', folding into a new internal IssueAccumulator with two separate fields -- orchTokensDeltaSum (summed) and orchTokensLegacyMax (collapsed via Math.max across all marker-absent events for that issue, since there is no orchestrator-session id to group repeated cumulative snapshots more precisely). collectPerIssue recomputes orchTokens = orchTokensLegacyMax + orchTokensDeltaSum and total = orchTokens + workerTokens for every rollup; the stored per-cycle detail['total'] field is no longer read/summed anywhere in the aggregator (write-side-only bookkeeping now). workerTokens is unaffected (still summed per-cycle regardless of mode). Public IssueTokenRollup/TokensPerIssueSummary shapes are unchanged, so split-advisory.ts and plan-split-advisory.ts needed zero changes. test/stats/tokens.test.ts's makeCycleTokensLine helper gained an optional 5th orchTokensMode param (default omitted = legacy); the pre-existing 'two cycle-tokens events... summed' test was renamed/narrowed to only assert workerTokens summing (its old orchTokens-summed expectation encoded the bug and is now covered instead by the new legacy/delta/mixed AC3 tests). test/supervisor/plan-split-advisory.test.ts gained an AC4 test building a 40-cycle legacy jobSize=1 stream (50k/cycle growth) directly through aggregateTokensPerIssue + computeSplitAdvisory, asserting the projected total stays under 10,000,000 instead of the ~41,000,000 a naive sum would have produced.
